topics.guidance: Separate ephemeral geospatial state from durable trip and payment state. Evaluate only the current question and stage; a justified alternative earns equal credit.

concepts.name: Location boundary

concepts.name: Matching service

topics.name: Core Flow

concepts.name: Fresh candidates
concepts.guidance: Use a spatial grid/index or another justified method, filter stale GPS and consider accuracy and road travel time.

concepts.name: Geohash, H3, R-tree or equivalent
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Fresh candidates. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Exclusive assignment
concepts.guidance: Use conditional offer reservations and fence stale acceptance. An expiring offer is not an accepted trip: retain authoritative driver ownership for accepted/in-progress trips until a terminal transition or explicit reconciled recovery.

concepts.name: Compare-and-set driver lease
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Exclusive assignment. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Dispatch retries. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.

concepts.name: Versioned trip transitions
concepts.guidance: Supporting example for Trip transitions. Reward equivalent mechanisms; do not require every listed alternative.
